content_necessity.gamma0_note: Forcing gamma=0 does not change completions at all, so the learned gate is already near zero: the byte-level copy path is not in use.

forced_record_oracle.note: It forced offset 0 of the object record, i.e. the description's first byte, while the answer starts with the template character. Reported only; no gate, per the revised rescue/oracle definition.

attribution_review.scope: instrument, wiring and aggregation only; no 300-update rerun, no dose or seed change

q1_reader_and_curriculum_wiring.reader_switch: wired: 164 shared parameters are bit-identical at init, outputs differ, and R0P0 vs R1P0 disagree on 74/240 (seed 28031) and 99/240 (seed 28032) dev examples; R1 dev NLL 0.466 vs R0 1.727
q1_reader_and_curriculum_wiring.curriculum_switch: wired: self_count_total is 984/979 for both R0P1 and R1P1 and 0 for P0 arms; a five-step probe shows a 12.4 (R1) and 17.8 (R0) TF-vs-self loss gap at init
q1_reader_and_curriculum_wiring.why_R1P0_equals_R1P1: the greedy self-prefix equals the teacher prefix on 8/8 train probes after training, and per-update losses are bit-identical for all 300 updates, so the P1 factor is inert for R1 by construction, not by a wiring bug
q1_reader_and_curriculum_wiring.arm_config_mapping: no misplacement; R1 arms carry reader.* parameters and trainable new groups

q2_source_top1_caliber.reason: the generator alone reproduces memorized template-plus-name answers for 100/240 dev examples (gamma0 rate 0.4167) while the reader never selects the goal-named object record (alpha 0/240). Correct byte strings can therefore coexist with wrong record selection.
q2_source_top1_caliber.estimator_note: the 1.1 report argmaxed byte-level copy weights at the first prediction; the intended record-level signal is alpha. Both give 0.0 on the saved step300 bundles, so the reading is real either way. Byte-level remains the weaker proxy and is recorded as such.

q3_R0P1_collapse.evidence: 198 updates differ from R0P0, final train loss 0.465 versus 8.65e-05, clip_max 1650.77 on seed 28031, and self_count 984. The old reader under a self-prefix curriculum is unstable at lr 1e-3 with the declared clip.

which_link_breaks: decoder gate: gamma is effectively zero after training, so the byte-level copy path never engages; gamma forcing changes nothing
selector: goal-conditioned record selection never forms; alpha accuracy is 0/240 on dev while train loss reaches 2e-05, i.e. train is satisfied by memorised pooled content
curriculum: the self-prefix factor arrives at update 101, after R1 has already copied train targets exactly, so it cannot test its hypothesis; on R0 the same dose destabilises training
architecture_diagnosis.not_the_break: the content vector is necessary (removing records drops completions from 0.4167 to 0.0), and identity rescue is bit-exact.

products.kept_reason: the four R1 step300 bundles reproduce the alpha/self-prefix re-check; the R0P1 bundle reproduces the collapse
products.deleted_reason: eight step150 checkpoints and three step300 bundles (both R0P0, one R0P1) that the verdict does not need

limits: Bounded native-byte task only. No confirm read, no N15.2, no step 12/13, no 14.7 release; no claim beyond this task and these arms.
